Silver Town sat high on the Indigo Plateau, and the terrain was difficult. Ash, Misty, and Brock needed to get down to lower ground before they could make the return trip to Kanto comfortably.

Ethan and Erika would go with them that far, then head for a nearby port and take a ship to Hoenn.

Once again, Ethan would begin exploring a new region ahead of Ash. Ash was eager to follow, but first he had to return to Pallet Town and spend a few days with his mother.

They talked as they walked. After more than an hour, they had descended from the plateau into a thick forest.

The path narrowed. With Erika walking ahead, Misty came up beside Ethan and whispered, Ethan, dont forget. You promised wed travel together.

He glanced at her teasingly. Whats this? You dont want to travel with Ash anymore?

Who wants to travel with a guy like him? Misty shook her head. When Ethan still did not mention his promise, she grew anxious. You said you would! You cant take it back.

Dont worry. Ethan laughed and patted her head. Go home first and let your sisters know youre safe. After that, you can come find me in Hoenn.

Few people seemed to visit the forest below the plateau. It had a wild, ancient feel, with tall trees so dense that their branches nearly hid the sky.

They passed a magnificent waterfall and followed the mountain path for a long while. At last, shortly before sunset, they reached a village standing among the trees.

It was a small and unusual place. Most of its buildings had been built in the branches of giant trees. Everywhere they looked, there were treehouses that seemed part of the forest itself.

Lets stay here for the night, Ethan said.

But the village was remote. They wandered through it without seeing many people, much less a restaurant or an inn.

After they had made two rounds, a woman hanging laundry outside one of the treehouses spotted them from behind its railing and waved.

Over here! Can I help you?

Ethan looked up. Were passing through and hoped to find somewhere to eat and stay. Is there an inn here?

Oh, its you! Now that she could see his face, the woman looked astonished. I watched your match yesterday. I never expected you to come to our village. We dont have anywhere for travelers to stay, but if you dont mind, youre welcome at my home.

Her home?

Ethan exchanged glances with Erika, Ash, and the others. They all nodded, so they went to the base of the tree and climbed the stairs.

Several wooden staircases joined the treehouse to the ground. The climb was no harder than going upstairs in an ordinary building. When they reached the outer deck, they could see their host clearly.

She looked about twenty-six or twenty-seven and was very pretty. Her long, pale green hair was tied in twin tails. She wore a pink tank top and jeans, giving her a bright, youthful look that seemed a little out of place in this rustic village. Most striking of all was the necklace around her neck, strung with three gleaming gold coins.

Welcome to Arborville. Im Diana.

Hello. Im Ethan.

Im Ash!

And Im Misty.

Erika was about to introduce herself when someone flashed past her. Brock had somehow dropped to one knee before Diana. Gazing up at her with tender eyes, he said in a deep voice, Im Brock. Who would have thought I could meet a beautiful lady like you in a village like this?

Erika had no words.

Fortunately, Misty gave Brock a sharp knock on the head before he could embarrass everyone further.

After the introductions, Diana invited them inside. The treehouse looked unusual from the outside, but its interior was much like any other wooden home.

An elderly woman was there too. She looked surprised to see Diana bringing in a group of strangers.

Diana, who are they?

Grandmother. Diana stepped aside. Theyre travelers passing through. This is Ethan, who won the Silver Conference yesterday. They needed somewhere to stay, so I invited them in.

Then she turned to the visitors. This is my grandmother, Towa. She watches over the entrance to the forest.

The entrance? Ethan and the others had never heard of such a role.

Towa studied the group. There was a man and woman at its center, two children, and a darker-skinned companion following along. They hardly looked like troublemakers.

Youre welcome here, she said. But I must warn you: if you go into the forest tomorrow and hear the voice of the forest, you must not move.

Unlike Diana, Towa wore traditional clothes and a headscarf. She carried a long wooden staff and looked rather like a tribal shaman. She too had a necklace of gold coins, though hers held five instead of three. Perhaps the difference reflected their positions in the village.

Um... Erika said. Which forest do you mean? We didnt hear anything on our way here.

I dont mean the ordinary forest you came through. I mean the Mysterious Forest behind us.

Towa looked out the window. Following her gaze, they saw a larger, denser stretch of ancient forest beyond the other side of the village.

The Mysterious Forest?

Is there something unusual about it? Erika asked cautiously.

Its an old village tradition, Diana said with a wave of her hand, answering for her grandmother. Then her expression grew serious. But if you dont want to get lost, you really should listen to her.

Ethan and the others looked toward the forest again. Unless they took a long detour, crossing it would be the shortest way to the next town. Both local women had given them a clear warning. Was there really something in those trees, some inexplicable power?

That makes me even more excited, Ash whispered. I want to go in right now! Do you think there are any amazing Pokemon in there?

Towa fell silent.

So did Diana.

They stared at the suddenly excited boy. They had spelled out the danger as plainly as they could. Why did that only make him more eager?

Did he not know how to be afraid?

That evening, Towa and Diana prepared a generous spread of local dishes for their guests. The main course was a thick vegetable and mushroom soup. It tasted wonderfully fresh, like something no big-city restaurant could ever reproduce.

I should take some of these seeds home, Erika whispered to Ethan after dinner.

He agreed wholeheartedly.

Still, he felt bad about eating and sleeping there without paying. Towa and Diana refused to accept a cent.

Please dont worry about it, Diana said, seeming to read his concern. Guests from afar have always been welcome here. Make yourselves at home.

Late that night, Diana settled them all in an empty treehouse. Ethan lay on a futon on the floor. Erika slept soundly to his left, beside the wall. Misty lay to his right, turning over again and again, perhaps too excited to sleep so close to him.

On the other side, Ash and Brock were fast asleep on their own bedding without a care in the world. Brock was already snoring.

Moonlight came through the window and fell across Ethans face.

Over dinner, he had finally remembered where they were. His memories of the movie were a little hazy, but this was unmistakably the village where Ash had met Celebi and Professor Oak as a boy.

Did that mean Ethan might get to see Celebi too?

He pulled his bag closer, searched through it, and took out the GS Ball.

At the sound, Misty turned toward him. She was startled when she saw the ball in his hand.

Huh? Ethan, isnt that the GS Ball? How did you get it?

Kurt gave it to me, Ethan said softly. Funny, isnt it? After all that, the ball ended up in my hands. And I have a feeling Ill have a chance to use it very soon.

Chapter 580: Sammy from Across Time

Early the next morning, after breakfast, Ethan and the others filled their water bottles, said goodbye to Towa and Diana, and headed for the Mysterious Forest.

Even its entrance was unusual. A giant tree that must have stood for countless years had fallen there. Someone had hollowed out its center, turning the trunk into a long passage.

It ran for at least twenty meters. Ethan could only imagine how magnificent the tree had been while it was still standing.

The fallen trunk separated Arborville from the Mysterious Forest. It was only a few dozen steps, yet when they emerged on the other side, even the air seemed different. Perhaps that was only their imagination.

Wild Pokemon were everywhere. Pidgey, Pidgeotto, and Butterfree flew overhead. Hoothoot, Spinarak, and Heracross perched among the trees. Rattata, Sentret, and Nidoran roamed the ground. They had barely entered the forest, and already the number of Pokemon around them was astonishing.

Perhaps they had gone so long without being disturbed by outsiders that they felt no fear of the intruding humans. They only tilted their heads and watched.

There are so many Pokemon here, Misty said.

She spotted several Weedle crawling on the ground, shuddered, and hurried to Ethans side.

There are. Theyre packed in here. Knowing how afraid Misty was of Bug-type Pokemon, Ethan kept her close. Then he looked toward Erika and Ash. Theres a remarkable variety too. If either of you wants to catch something, this is a good opportunity.

Both shook their heads. They had already caught the Pokemon they wanted, and nothing they had seen here tempted them to make another attempt.

They walked for another half hour, heading deeper into the forest. Then an endless wash of blue-green light swept toward them from beyond the trees. In an instant it spread through the forest around them and colored the canopy overhead.

As the light flashed past, an ethereal voice sounded in their ears.

What was that? Ash looked around in confusion. After his first moment of alarm, he realized the light had neither hurt nor affected him and began to relax.

That must be the voice of the forest Towa warned us about, Ethan said. He looked around and pointed. The light and the sound came from over there. Lets have a look.

He strode off in that direction, and Ash and the others hurried after him. Erika lingered at the rear, about to remind them that Towa had said they must not move if they heard the voice.

Then she thought better of it. They were Trainers, naturally curious about anything unknown. A warning would not satisfy them until they had seen for themselves what had happened.

She wanted to see it too.

With a helpless shake of her head, she hurried to catch up.

They crossed a stream, climbed a slope, and after another ten minutes reached a moss-covered altar.

Calling it an altar was generous. It was little more than a pile of stones with a small stone tablet set on top.

Just as they arrived, a brilliant light flashed. A boy holding a strange Pokemon appeared out of nowhere and dropped to the ground before the altar.

The Pokemon wriggled free of his arms the instant they appeared, flew into the air, and vanished into the nearby trees.

Ethan had caught only a glimpse, but it was enough. That had been Celebi, the legendary Mythical Pokemon.

So it really was that part of the movie!

And the boy who had just appeared must be Professor Oak, brought from the past into the present.

Ash and the others had already run to the boy and helped him up.

Wake up! Are you all right? Ash called.

The boy did not respond.

Erika examined him and frowned. Hes breathing, but he may be hurt. Lets take him back to the village first.

With an unconscious boy to care for, they could hardly continue their journey. Ethan brought out Tyranitar and had it carry him.

They retraced their steps through the forest and returned to Arborville.

Towa and Diana were startled to see them again barely an hour after they had left.

What happened? Towa asked.

We found someone unconscious in the forest!

Diana hurried to fetch a first-aid kit. By the time she and Towa came down from the treehouse, the boy had begun to wake.

He had plainly been frightened just before he fainted. The moment he opened his eyes and saw Ash close to him, he shoved him to the ground.

I wont hand Celebi over to you!

What was that for? Ash landed hard on his backside. Angry and bewildered, he sprang up, grabbed the boy by the collar, and began struggling with him.

Hey, stop! Brock and Misty rushed in and pulled them apart. Both of you, calm down!

The boy seemed to come to his senses. He looked around blankly, unable to understand where he was. Wh-what happened?

Towa and Diana arrived with the first-aid kit. As soon as Towa saw his face, she gave a small gasp, then hurried to him in astonishment.

Youre the boy from back then... Oh, thank goodness. Thank goodness...

Everyone was startled by her reaction. Grandmother, do you know him? Diana asked.

Towa turned to her. Do you remember the boy I told you about? The one who disappeared in this forest forty years ago?

What? You mean this is him?

Towa nodded and looked back at the boy. Yes. I remember him clearly. Its him.

Hearing them, the boy seemed to realize something. He stared at the elderly woman and murmured, Youre the girl who gave me bread...

Their disjointed conversation left Erika, Ash, and the others thoroughly confused. Only Ethan looked as though things were going exactly as he had expected.

Towa led everyone up to her treehouse.

After they sat on the sofas in the living room, she took a bundle wrapped in thick cloth from a cabinet and handed it to the boy.

Look at this. Is it something you lost?

He unwrapped the bundle. Inside was an old, worn notebook.

It is mine... But how...?

He recognized the notebook he always carried. It had been beside him only a moment ago, so how could it have ended up here? Its pages were yellowed and darkened, as if it had been stored away for years.

He looked up at Towa. Before he could ask, she said, I believe youve traveled through time.

Her words caused an uproar. Erika, Brock, and Misty all stared in shock. Their world held many strange powers, but traveling through time was something they had never heard of.

The boy and Ash, meanwhile, only looked blank.

One of them could not accept what he had heard. The other simply did not understand it.

Ash tilted his head. What does that mean?

Diana set cups of tea before them and explained, It means this boy crossed forty years of time to appear here. He looks exactly as he did when my grandmother saw him forty years ago.

Ash finally understood. No way!

He studied the boy beside him, but nothing about him looked forty years old. Ash was about to ask whether they had made a mistake. Then he remembered the blue-green light that had flashed through the forest when they found him and swallowed the question.

The boy stared at his notebook a moment longer, then suddenly cried, Celebi! Wheres Celebi?

Celebi?

Ash and the others shook their heads. They had reached the altar a few steps behind Ethan and had missed the Pokemon flying away.

There was a Pokemon with me, wasnt there? the boy asked.

Misty searched her memory, then shook her head. Sorry. We didnt see one. You were lying there alone when we arrived.

Ethan lifted his tea and took a quiet sip, looking as though none of this concerned him. He felt like a player waiting for a familiar story to advance: listen to the conversation, and the next event would follow.

Only Towa leaned forward and asked gravely, You saw Celebi?

The boy hesitated, then nodded.

After hearing the name so many times, Ash could not hold back any longer. Who is this Celebi you keep talking about?

Celebi is a Mythical Pokemon, Towa said, her expression complicated. We also call it the God of the Forest. It gives life to the forest and has the power to travel through time.

Brock looked at the boy. Then Celebis power is what brought him to our time?

Towa nodded. Yes. Only Celebi could do that.

So thats why we saw that strange light and heard the voice in the forest, Misty said. It was Celebi.

According to legend, Celebi lives beside the Lake of Life deep in the Mysterious Forest, Towa said with a frown. But no one has ever actually seen it travel through time before. I dont know why it brought you here.

Celebi was badly hurt. Someone was trying to capture it, and I... The boy suddenly stood. Thats right! I have to go. That person might still be after Celebi. I have to save it!

Im coming with you! Ash leaped to his feet, his quarrel with the boy apparently forgotten.

You can count us in too, Misty said, rising. Were strong Trainers. We couldnt just stand by and let this happen!

Thank you... The boy looked touched. Then he realized something and gave an apologetic smile. Oh, Im sorry. I havent even introduced myself. My names Sammy.

Im Ash. Im going to be a Pokemon Master, and this is my partner, Pikachu.

Im Brock. I used to be a Gym Leader, and now Im a pretty good Pokemon Breeder, if I say so myself!

Im Misty. Remember, Im a world-class beauty!

When Sammy looked his way, Ethan finished his tea and stood. He introduced himself, then gestured to Erika beside him.

Im Ethan. As you can see, Im a Trainer too. This is my companion, Erika.

They knew there was no time to lose. Once the introductions were done, they said goodbye to Towa and Diana and left the treehouse together.

Sammy was not seriously hurt. Fear and the strain of crossing through time had made him faint, but after a short rest he was himself again.

Ash and the others might never learn who Sammy really was. Ethan knew perfectly well: he was Professor Oak as a boy.

Professor Oaks full name was Samuel Oak. At the moment, he was only in his teens, still young-faced, traveling alone and sketching during his school vacation.

Ethan had no intention of telling Ash or the others. He would not even tell Erika.

Traveling through time defied common sense. If too many people became entangled in it, the consequences could be impossible to undo. The fewer people who knew Sammys identity, the safer it would be.

They left the village, passed through the hollow trunk once more, and entered the Mysterious Forest.

It was their second time walking this path today, but no one was impatient with the repetition. Ash and the others were excited at the prospect of seeing a legendary Mythical Pokemon. Even their steps seemed lighter.

They headed deeper into the forest, searching as they went. A long walk brought them no trace of Celebi.

Then Pikachu seemed to sense something. Its ears twitched, and it darted into the bushes in another direction.

Ethan and Ash knew how keen Pikachus senses could be, so they followed. Soon they reached a broad clearing. Two trunks as huge as the one outside the village lay crossed on the ground. Farther away, a crowd of wild Pokemon had gathered around a hollow in a tree. From where the group stood, they could not tell what the Pokemon were doing.

Chapter 581: Vicious Joins Forces with the Trio

They hardly needed to ask what the wild Pokemon had gathered around.

Celebi might be hiding inside that hollow!

Ethan and the others exchanged glances, then hurried toward the two fallen trunks. The wild Pokemon did not try to stop them. They simply turned and watched with curious eyes.

At the base of the lower trunk, the path ended. Fortunately, a vine hung down from above. Ash jumped up, caught it, and began climbing without a second thought.

There was only one vine, and it swung under his weight. Everyone else had to wait for him to reach the top before using it to climb onto the trunk.

Watching him scramble halfway up in no time, Misty laughed. Hes fast. Even a Mankey would have to admit defeat.

The others laughed too. With climbing skills that nimble, Ash could put even a primate Pokemon raised in the forest to shame.

Of course it would, Ethan teased. You think a human-shaped Pokemon is a joke? Put Ash on a battlefield, and I bet an ordinary Pokemon couldnt beat him!

Once Ash reached the top, Sammy, Misty, and Brock climbed after him.

Ethan chose an easier way. He brought out Dragonite, who carried him and Erika up to the trunk.

When Ethan jumped down from Dragonites back, the surface felt slick beneath his feet.

The trunk was broad, but moss covered it. They had to watch every step.

The Pokemon outside the hollow moved aside as they approached. Ethan looked in and saw a small, light green Pokemon lying weakly inside. It had a round head.

Thats Celebi? Ash and Misty exclaimed together. Realizing how loud they were, they quickly lowered their voices.

Sammy nodded. He knelt on the trunk and held out his hand. Come out...

But he had underestimated how wary Celebi was. It had brought him through time in a moment of danger, probably without meaning to. The two did not actually know each other.

Despite Sammys warm smile and gentle voice, Celebi shrank back from his approaching hand. A violent shock wave burst from its body and swept outward.

Everyone nearby was thrown away. Ash and Sammy, who were closest, took the full force and flew several meters.

The others were hit less severely. Erika and Brock were standing to one side and felt the least of it.

Misty was light enough to be lifted off her feet. Fortunately, Ethan stood behind her. She fell into his arms, and they staggered back together until Dragonites soft belly stopped them.

Dragonite tilted its head, bent down, and helped its Trainer and Misty stand straight.

Ash landed at the edge of the trunk and almost fell. He grabbed the hanging vine just in time.

He clambered back up, using both hands and feet, and returned to the hollow. That was dangerous! Were not bad people!

Perhaps his tone sounded threatening. Celebi used its power again. Branches and leaves beside the hollow grew wildly and lashed at Ash, whipping him away from the opening.

Both of you, calm down. Ethan sighed at their recklessness. Celebi is weak, helpless, and frightened of humans right now. Rushing at it wont work.

Oh. I see...

Ash realized he had been too hasty. Smiling now, he approached Celebi again.

Sorry I scared you. Were good people. We came to help!

No matter how nicely he spoke, the branches kept swatting at his face.

Let me try, Erika said.

She came to the hollow. Perhaps it was the natural air about her, or perhaps her beautiful face, but Celebi seemed to relax a little.

The branches slowed. Erika reached in carefully and lifted Celebi into her hands. They stopped moving altogether.

Ethan could only stare.

If he had not known Celebi had no gender, he might have thought the little creature was attracted to pretty women. Why else had it relaxed the moment Erika took Ashs place?

Was that simply her advantage?

As Erika brought Celebi out, they finally saw it clearly.

Its body was green, pale above and grass green below. Its large, rounded head gave it the look of a doll. A pair of wings rose from its back, and green antennae tipped in blue grew from its forehead. It was adorable.

The others immediately crowded around, taken with it at once. Celebi blinked its big eyes and looked from one person to another.

But it was injured. Once it had seen that these humans meant it no harm, it could hold out no longer. Its eyes closed, and it fell into a deep sleep.

In truth, this was a rare chance to catch it.

The rarer a Pokemon was, the harder it was to find. A Mythical Pokemon like Celebi was rarer still. In its present condition, a single thrown Poke Ball might be enough.

But Ethan could not do that.

Sammy would surely stop him, and Ash and Brock would probably object as well. More than that, Ethan himself did not want to take advantage of an injured Pokemon.

He would wait until this affair was over and look for a chance to catch Celebi on his own.

For now, they needed to treat its injuries. They had medicine with them, but it would only be enough for first aid. After discussing it with everyone, Sammy decided they should take Celebi back to Arborville for proper care.

Ethan thought of flying Erika and Celebi there on Dragonite. Sammy pointed out that, if someone was hunting Celebi, the sky might be no safer. It would be slower to travel together, but they would be stronger as a group. A Pokemon hunter might think twice before attacking them all.

Ethan was about to promise that he could drive off any hunter who appeared.

Then another thought stopped him. If he separated from Sammy and the others, the next part of the movies story might not happen as it should. Until the events played out and the danger was resolved, Sammy could not return to his own time. And Ethan would have no chance to catch Celebi.

He let the matter drop. Together with Ash and the others, he climbed down from the trunk and started back toward Arborville.

Everyone except Ethan was anxious. They hoped the return journey would pass without trouble.

But events had a way of going wrong at the very moment one most feared them.

Halfway back, as they reached a stream, several smoke bombs burst at their feet.

Bang! Bang!

Thick smoke billowed up, swallowing the whole group in an instant.

Cough, cough...

Ash stumbled out of the cloud with tears in his eyes. Whos there? he shouted.

As if his question were a cue, two familiar voices answered from ahead.

Since you asked us so sincerely!

Well tell you out of the kindness of our hearts!

To protect the world from devastation!

To unite all peoples within our nation!

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

To extend our reach to the stars above!

The cute and charming villains!

Im Jessie!

And Im James!

We are Team Rocket, blasting through the galaxy!

A white hole! A white future is waiting for us!

Thats right, meow!

Only the endlessly persistent Team Rocket trio could deliver those lines with such ease and confidence.

Jessie, James, Meowth, and Wobbuffet stood on a tree not far ahead, looking down at them.

It had been a long time since Ethan last heard their entrance speech. More precisely, it had been a long time since they dared show themselves in front of him. On previous occasions, they usually hid until he had gone before emerging again. They certainly had not tried to trouble him.

They still followed Ash almost everywhere. But for them to appear so openly before Ethan today meant something was wrong.

Team Rocket! Misty called, frowning. Leave us alone. Were busy!

Ahahaha! Jessie covered her mouth with one finger and laughed theatrically. Enough talk. Hand over the Celebi youre carrying!

So Celebi was their target. The incident had only just happened. They could not have learned of it this quickly unless someone were directing them.

The smoke had almost cleared. While everyone watched the trio, two long mechanical claws shot out with a whir and lunged at Erika.

More precisely, they reached for the Celebi in her arms.

No one else had time to react. Ethan alone had remained on guard. The instant he saw the claws, he pulled Erika into his arms.

Ash and the others heard the rush of air behind them and spun around in shock.

What?

The claws missed. Their owner finally showed himself.

A huge black robot, shaped like a pillar, stepped slowly out from behind a giant tree. In its cockpit sat a man in a yellow hood and a red vest.

Ethan recognized the outfit immediately. It was Vicious, the Iron Masked Marauder, a Pokemon hunter and high-ranking Team Rocket executive.

What rotten luck. Ethan had known Vicious was central to Celebis story, but after their clash in Blackthorn Citys Dragon Holy Land, he had not expected the man to evade Clairs pursuit and turn up here.

You dodged that too? Vicious said. Impressive.

His gaze remained fixed on Ethan. He had been here for some time. Spotting Ethan from a distance, he had recognized a formidable opponent and held back instead of revealing himself.

Ordinarily, he would have slipped away unnoticed. But Celebi was the Pokemon he had long dreamed of capturing. If he let this chance pass, who knew when he would encounter it again? He could not bring himself to leave.

While he searched for a way to break the deadlock, he happened upon the trio lurking nearby. After a short exchange, he learned they were Team Rocket members too, and devised a simple plan.

It was clear now that their diversion had failed.

Youre here for Celebi, arent you, Vicious? Ethan asked, though he knew the answer. You got lucky and escaped last time. I didnt expect you to come to me yourself. You wont be so fortunate today.

Ash frowned at the sharp exchange. Ethan, you know him?

Ethan nodded. Hes a senior Team Rocket executive and a Pokemon hunter. He broke into the Dragon Holy Land near Blackthorn City to capture the Dragon-type Pokemon there. Lance, Clair, and I stopped him.

His outfit alone had made his Team Rocket allegiance obvious. After hearing Ethans account, Ash and the others grew even more wary.

Brock turned to Sammy. Was he the hunter you met before?

Sammy shook his head. No. That was another hunter.

The hunters were different, but they both wanted Celebi. Ash and his friends would not let this one have it.

Jessie, James, and Meowth jumped down from the tree. With Vicious on the opposite side, Ethans group was caught between them.

The trio had badly misread the situation. They thought that joining forces with a highly regarded Team Rocket executive would be enough to beat Ethan and his friends.

Still, it looked like a chance to turn their fortunes around. If they won, they could settle old scores and seize the Mythical Pokemon Celebi. Their standing in Team Rocket would change beyond recognition.

And if they lost?

They would be sent flying, just as they had hundreds of times before. They were used to that.

They were still afraid of Ethan, but taking this gamble might bring a tremendous reward, and failure would cost them little more than usual. Why not try?

Chapter 582: A Temporary Retreat

The mood had reached a breaking point. Everyone knew a battle was unavoidable.

They reached for their Poke Balls almost together. More than a dozen flashes of blue light filled the clearing as Pokemon appeared beside their Trainers.

Jessie and James sent out almost every Pokemon they had. Their team was still small; even counting Meowth and Wobbuffet, they had only six.

Erika, Misty, and Brock were not traveling to train their teams, so they carried relatively few Pokemon too. Erika had caught some new Grass-type partners recently, but none were ready to fight yet.

Besides, she was holding the unconscious Celebi. She had no hands free for a battle.

That left Misty and Brock to face the trio.

Even so, the two former Gym Leaders had the advantage in both numbers and strength. Barring any surprises, they should have no trouble dealing with Jessie, James, and Meowth.

But the trio had a chance. They were capable fighters in their own way, and as the attackers, they had no reason to hold back. There was also no telling what strange invention they might bring out. Misty and Brock had the better odds, but they still had to be careful.

The real problem was Vicious.

It was not that his Pokemon were especially powerful on their own. He had Dark Balls that could forcibly capture another persons Pokemon and make them stronger and more vicious.

Back in the Dragon Holy Land, Vicious had used one to control Lances Dragonite, causing them no end of trouble.

Be careful, Ethan warned Ash. He has Dark Balls that can steal other peoples Pokemon. Dont let him catch any of yours.

Thats easy to say... Ash suddenly felt overwhelmed. How was he supposed to battle while worrying that his opponent might steal his Pokemon?

Vicious gave them a cold smile.

Since his previous defeat, the Dragon Tamers had been hunting him. He now kept plenty of Dark Balls close at hand. They were the main reason he had escaped capture again and again and was still living well.

Let me show you my latest addition! He pulled a Dark Ball from his vest and hurled it. Go, my Dark Tyranitar!

Black light flashed. A Tyranitar that looked deeply unnatural appeared before them.

Darkness shone in its eyes and seeped from its body. Under the Dark Balls control, it seemed to have lost all reason. It radiated menace and destructive power.

It threw back its head and roared. Before the sound had faded over the forest, energy gathered in its mouth. An instant later, an immense Hyper Beam shot toward Ethans group.

Watch out!

The beam was visibly thick and powerful. Everyone scattered. It tore through the space between them and struck a giant tree in the distance.

That was close. Ethan had felt the heat as it passed.

The ancient tree was more than ten meters across, yet the beam punched straight through and split it in two. It went on to strike a rocky hill, tearing away a great section before it finally faded.

How can it be... so powerful? Ash and the others stared, finally understanding how frightening a Dark Ball could be.

The attack startled the Team Rocket trio too. They were nearest its path, and the shock wave nearly knocked them off their feet. Once they recovered, however, they were delighted by Dark Tyranitars strength.

With a senior executive and a Pokemon like that on their side, revenge was within reach. They could teach Ethan a lesson and steal Pikachu while they were at it!

Elated, they ordered their Pokemon to attack. Misty and Brock had to meet them in haste.

Once fighting began, everyone was drawn into it. Ash gritted his teeth and sent out Muk and Bayleef. Sammy took an old-fashioned Poke Ball shaped like a flask from his coat, twisted off its cap, and released his Charmeleon.

Young Samuel Oak was neither a Pokemon researcher nor much of a Trainer yet. His Charmeleon was not especially robust, but it had spirit. Far from cowering before Dark Tyranitar, it opened its jaws and gave the larger Pokemon a threatening cry.

It was surprising to see the venerable, kindly Professor Oaks first Pokemon as a youth: a fierce, aggressive Charmeleon.

With Pikachu among them, their Pokemon began to close around Dark Tyranitar from both sides. Vicious, however, had no intention of facing them with only one Pokemon.

He threw two more Dark Balls. A Sneasel and a Scizor appeared beside Tyranitar, the same black light in their eyes.

The Pokemon collided at once. Ashs partners had grown strong during his travels, but the enhanced Dark Pokemon still had a slight edge.

Dark Tyranitar in particular seemed to have strength without limit. It fired Hyper Beam again and again, apparently unaffected by the moves usual exhaustion.

Ash and his friends had to fight their immediate opponents while watching for its attacks. They could not let their attention wander for an instant.

Ethan studied the battle for a long moment, then cautiously took a Poke Ball from his belt.

The two sides looked evenly matched. Dark Tyranitar was the deciding factor.

If they could defeat it, the battle would swing their way.

But Ethan could not send all his Pokemon against it. He needed one powerful partner fighting alone, someone he could recall at once if Vicious threw a Dark Ball.

That made the choice difficult.

At last he turned to the partner he trusted most: Gardevoir.

Her Teleport could carry her to safety if Vicious tried to capture her, greatly reducing the danger.

Gardevoir, find a way to draw its attention!

Gardevoir moved toward Dark Tyranitar and attacked with Confusion. The move had worked countless times before, but Tyranitars strength was too great. She could not lift it.

Surprised, Ethan immediately ordered the stronger Psychic. This time Gardevoir drove Dark Tyranitar back several steps.

That got its attention. It turned on her and fired another Hyper Beam.

One hit from that enormous column of energy could leave her gravely hurt, if it did not kill her outright. Other Pokemon might have struggled to dodge it. Gardevoir vanished with Teleport and reappeared beyond its path.

She escaped. The forest behind her did not.

Trees and rocks shattered in an instant. Splinters and fragments covered the ground, and the beam gouged a deep furrow through the earth.

Dark Tyranitar was terrifyingly strong. The Dark Balls power had turned its Hyper Beam into destruction on a scale Ethan had seldom seen.

If it kept firing, the ruined trees would be the least of their concerns. A forest fire would be far worse.

Gengar! Ethan called down to his shadow. Help her. Use Hypnosis!

Gengar emerged without a word. It too seemed to understand the danger. Rings of hypnotic light spread from its wide eyes toward Dark Tyranitar.

The Hypnosis hit.

But the Dark Balls control was stronger. Dark energy filled Tyranitars body and stimulated its mind. The move had no effect.

Ethan clicked his tongue. What a nuisance.

From the cockpit of his spider-shaped machine, Vicious watched with a smug smile.

Dark Balls increased the strength of the Pokemon they controlled, but the degree of that increase depended on the Pokemon. In the Dragon Holy Land, he had controlled Lances Dragonite. To be honest, its boost had disappointed him.

This Tyranitar was different. Perhaps it was powerful to begin with, or perhaps it was especially suited to the Dark Ball. Together, they produced far more than either could alone.

If he controlled several Tyranitar like this, would anyone be able to defeat him?

Before he could enjoy the thought, the fight changed elsewhere.

Jessie, James, and Meowth were simply no match for Misty and Brock. Even with more Pokemon on their side, they soon began to lose.

They were cunning enough to recognize it. Before they could be sent flying, the trio slipped away and escaped.

Their departure put Vicious under immediate pressure.

Misty and Brock joined the other battle, attacking from the sides. They chose their targets well. Instead of challenging Tyranitar first, they helped Ash and Sammy defeat Dark Sneasel and Dark Scizor.

With those two out of the way, everyone turned on Dark Tyranitar together.

For all its strength, it could not answer so many attacks at once. It soon had no chance to destroy anything else and was forced to defend itself.

Vicious silently cursed the useless trio. His hand crept toward the remaining Dark Balls on the front of his vest.

Sammy had been watching him carefully ever since Ethan warned them that he could steal Pokemon.

He spotted the movement and cried out, Hes going to use his Dark Balls! Be careful!

Everyone looked at Vicious and saw what he intended. Their assault faltered.

Ethan assessed the field. We cant keep fighting like this. Celebi needs treatment. Lets get out of here.

Ash and the others regained their heads. They nodded, realizing that prolonging the battle would do Celebi no good.

They exchanged a look and ran together toward an opening in the trees.

The trio was no longer blocking their path, and Dark Tyranitar could not catch up from behind. Leaving proved surprisingly easy.

They plunged into the forest and ran a long way. When they finally looked back, Vicious was nowhere in sight.

He was not pursuing them. For the moment, they could breathe again.

Back at the battleground, three heads rose from the bushes as soon as Ethans group had gone.

Jessie, James, and Meowth saw Vicious still sitting in his mechanical spider, with Dark Tyranitar unharmed beside him. Smiling ingratiatingly, they approached.

Lord Vicious. James rubbed his hands together. Youre amazing! You actually drove Ethan and those brats away.

Vicious glanced at the cowards and gave a contemptuous snort.

They belonged to Team Rocket, but he had heard their names and all the tales of their disastrous exploits. He had assumed those stories were exaggerated jokes. Now he saw that they really were hopeless.

Fortunately, he had never counted on them for much.

When Vicious did not answer, James glanced in the direction Ethan had fled. Um... Arent you going after them? If we wait, theyll get too far away.

What would you know? Vicious smiled coldly. Catching prey, especially something as rare as Celebi, is more interesting when theres a challenge. A hunter should enjoy the pursuit.

Chapter 583: Eevee: Three Meals a Day with Humans

After fleeing the battle, Ethan and the others lost the path back to Arborville and ran deeper into the forest. Only when they reached a lake did they realize they no longer knew which way to go.

Forest stretched in every direction. The trees were so thick with branches and leaves that every view looked the same.

Are we lost? Ash scratched his head.

Thats all right, Brock said. We ran without any clear destination. Even that Pokemon hunter will have a hard time tracking us.

The sun was sinking. Ethan looked at his exhausted companions and decided against pressing on. Weve come a long way. Vicious shouldnt catch up with us for now. Lets camp here tonight.

No one objected. At the news that they could rest, Misty dropped onto a nearby rock and gasped for breath.

She was drenched in sweat, her clothes soaked through. Even if she wanted to keep running, her legs would not carry her.

They had been on the move since morning, going back and forth between the village and forest and then fighting a hard battle. Everyone was hungry.

At Brocks direction, their Pokemon searched for branches and berries while he began preparing dinner.

Ethan sent out Jolteon and Eevee and stationed them at hidden points on opposite sides of the camp. They would warn everyone if Vicious appeared. Then he returned to Erika.

With each person tending to a task, the camp took shape quickly. They built a fire and set out their tents and sleeping bags.

Outside the tent she shared with Ethan, Erika had given Celebi emergency treatment. It had rested for some time, and its breathing was steady. It no longer seemed to be in danger.

How is it? Ethan asked as he sat beside her.

Its all right. I think itll wake soon. Erika looked at him and lowered her voice. You want to catch it, dont you?

Huh? Ethan raised his eyebrows. You figured that out?

Erika smiled. Youve made it obvious. Youve been sneaking looks at Celebi all day. I can tell what youre thinking.

Ethan stared for a moment, then laughed.

After so many nights together, they knew each other intimately. Just as he had grown familiar with every inch of her, she had learned to read his small gestures and hidden wishes.

What about you? he asked. Celebi is a Grass- and Psychic-type Mythical Pokemon. The Grass typing suits you perfectly.

Me? Erika stroked Celebis large head. Of course I like it. But liking a Pokemon doesnt mean I have to catch it. And I know you want it more than I do. Why would I try to take that chance from you?

Her unexpected kindness touched him. If the others had not been nearby, he would have kissed her deeply.

He slipped an arm around her. Whether you catch it or I do hardly matters. Whats yours is mine, and whats mine is yours.

They did not know that Misty, sitting close enough to hear, was shaking her head at their sugary exchange.

She was not jealous of their relationship. She understood how they felt about each other and had long since accepted it. She just found their whispered conversation a little funny.

She knew she was still a minor and could not compete with Erika for Ethans attention on equal terms. She glanced down at her undeveloped figure and sighed.

If she wanted to win Ethan over, she would have to wait until she was grown up.

The previous night, she had not understood why Ethan had suddenly taken out the GS Ball. The moment she saw Celebi today, it all made sense. Ethan was going to try to catch it.

Misty did not know how he had anticipated finding Celebi here, but like Erika, she did not mind his wish to catch it. She would support the person she cared about.

And if Celebi were going to be caught, she could think of no one more worthy of such a rare Mythical Pokemon than Ethan.

The smell of dinner drifted across the camp. When Brock called them over, nearly everyone appeared at once.

Wearing an apron, Brock served each person like a devoted parent. He was about to put the pot back over the fire when he noticed Celebi hovering beside the table.

Celebi? Youre awake?

Everyone turned. Celebi, who should still have been asleep, was in the air beside the food, sniffing eagerly at the plates with its tiny nose.

It moved with such ease that it seemed fully recovered.

It must be hungry, Misty said. Brocks cooking smelled so good it woke up.

Ash laughed. Youre a little glutton, arent you?

It made sense. Celebi had lived in this forest eating berries every day. However sweet they were, it had probably grown tired of them. Now the scent of cooked food was irresistible.

Brock filled a plate for Celebi. The instant he set it down, it dove in and began eating with great enthusiasm.

Seeing Celebi enjoy it made the others hungrier. They turned to their own plates.

For a while, no one spoke. They were too busy filling their stomachs. The only sounds were utensils tapping against plates.

When Celebi finished, it licked its lips and fixed its eyes on Brock.

Brock shook his head helplessly and gave it another full plate.

After the meal, Celebi seemed to have forgotten its fear of them entirely. With its stomach round from food, it flew curiously from person to person. It showed none of its earlier caution and made no attempt to leave.

Its nature seemed innocent and curious about humans. It was nothing like the fierce Legendary or Mythical Pokemon Ethan had met, or those that only hid from people.

Despite their sleepiness, Ash and the others played with Celebi for a while. Eventually they could stay awake no longer. Yawning, they crawled into their sleeping bags.

Ethan and Erika went into their tent and soon fell asleep. Celebi, however, remained outside. The lively camp had gone quiet so quickly that it felt lonely.

The moon hung high over the still lake. Celebi looked up at its light and thought about how much these humans had changed its life in such a short time.

It had never experienced a battle like that, or tasted food so delicious.

Light footsteps sounded nearby. Jolteon emerged from the trees.

Without looking at Celebi, it held its head high and scanned the camp. Once it was satisfied there was no danger, it turned and set off in the other direction.

Celebi fluttered its delicate wings and followed.

It had never met Jolteon, but its scent told Celebi that it belonged with the humans. Pokemon raised by humans were unfamiliar to Celebi. It wondered how their lives differed from its own.

Jolteon threaded through the trees. It glanced once at Celebi behind it, then paid the visitor no further attention.

With a few leaps, it crossed the bushes and the stream that fed the lake, reaching the other side of camp.

This was Eevees assigned watch area. Jolteon searched for a long while before finding it asleep in a thicket.

Jolteon placed a forepaw on Eevee. To its surprise, Eevee did not wake. It grumbled, rolled over, and went right on sleeping.

Jolteon did not hesitate again. A quick electric shock served as a wake-up call.

Crackle!

Eevee jerked awake and leaped up in pain. Thinking it had been attacked, it prepared to fight back. Then it saw Jolteon and wilted like a plant after a frost.

Celebi hovered overhead, holding its belly as it laughed. It did not know what Eevee had done, but it was clearly in trouble.

Eevee noticed Celebi above it. Unlike the aloof Jolteon, it had an exuberant nature. It called softly to the newcomer, and they soon began playing together.

Jolteon shook its head at the sight. Evidently guarding the camp was a job it would have to do alone.

Leaving them to play, Jolteon resumed its patrol.

From Eevee, Celebi learned roughly what separated wild Pokemon from Pokemon who lived with humans.

Most obviously, the latter had a more comfortable life. They did not have to worry about finding food every day.

With wide, innocent eyes, Eevee explained that living with humans meant three meals a day. Someone would bathe it when it was dirty. It had a soft bed when it was tired, help with training and growing stronger, and freedom to do as it pleased.

Celebi remembered the food it had just eaten. It was so envious that its mouth watered.

Compared with the berries it had always known, human food was wonderful.

...

They all slept soundly through the night.

Morning light spread across the camp and drove away the darkness. A new day had begun.

When Ethan came out of his tent, he immediately saw Eevee and Celebi chasing each other through the camp.

He rubbed his eyes, unable to believe it. When had those two become friends?

He stepped back into the tent, lifted the flap, and looked out again. They were still playing. He had not imagined it.

What is it? Erika asked from behind him when he lingered at the entrance.

Nothing. Im just surprised Eevee didnt keep watch properly. It neglected its post to play with Celebi.

Fortunately, Ethan trusted Jolteon to have taken up the burden of patrolling through the night. Otherwise, a surprise attack from Vicious could have caught them helpless.

Eevee still needed more discipline.

Ethan had no idea what Eevee had told Celebi overnight. He called Eevee over and gave it a firm warning. Meanwhile, Brock rose, washed, and began making breakfast. Celebi soon appeared beside him, watching with eager anticipation.

Hungry? Brock asked gently. Just wait a little. Itll be ready soon.

When the generous breakfast was served, Celebi gobbled it down. The others could only laugh.

Even Misty pressed a hand to her forehead. It looks so cute. I never thought it would be such a glutton.

After breakfast, they packed up and set off again.

To guard against another attack by Vicious, they decided to return to Arborville first. He and Team Rocket might hesitate to strike in a village full of people. The villagers could also help, leaving Ethans group less exposed than they had been yesterday.

Ash sent out Noctowl to fly above the canopy and find their direction. Following its guidance, they headed for the village.

The walk was tense. No one knew where Vicious was or when he might attack. The uncertainty kept them ready for a fight at any moment.

Celebi fluttered over their heads. They chatted now and then. The mood was hardly cheerful, but at least the journey was not silent.

As they drew closer to Arborville, the danger they had feared finally arrived.

Air whistled past the trees. Two long mechanical arms shot from behind them and snatched at Celebi in the air.

Everyone was ready this time. The Pokemon walking guard reacted as soon as the claws appeared.

Pikachu sprang high and struck one arm aside with a powerful Iron Tail.

Chapter 584: Dark Celebi

The attacker was, of course, Vicious.

Both mechanical claws had been knocked aside. Vicious guided his enormous spider-shaped robot out from behind the trees, with Jessie, James, and Meowth still close beside him.

Yesterdays failure had not made him give up on the trio. He had kept them with him.

Did you think you could escape? Vicious snarled. After a nights rest, its time for round two!

Hand over Celebi! Jessie shouted.

And Pikachu! Meowth added.

The trio sounded fierce, but their bravado was thin. Yesterday they had attacked with confidence and lost anyway. Even with a senior executive on their side, they now knew better than to assume victory.

They had stayed because they were unwilling to let the chance go and wanted one more try.

If it ended as yesterdays attack had, they would abandon Vicious without a second thought and run.

You really wont give up! Sammy frowned. He released Charmeleon again, and Ash and the others hurried to bring out their Pokemon to guard the group.

I advise you to stop this pointless resistance. Vicious showed no fear. He released Dark Tyranitar once more.

Roar!

As soon as it appeared, Dark Tyranitar fired another Hyper Beam. No one could stand against that force. Ethan and the others scattered to dodge.

The beam broke their formation.

Jessie and James seized the opening, sending their Pokemon to attack. In an instant, the forest was thrown into chaos again.

But Viciouss plan was different today. He did not waste time battling the people in his way. He took out a Dark Ball and threw it directly at Celebi.

Look out!

Ash had been watching him. The moment the ball left Viciouss hand, Ash flung his backpack into the air. It struck the Dark Ball and knocked it aside.

He could protect Celebi once, but not twice.

Vicious calmly drew another Dark Ball and threw it. This time Ash could not interfere. Black light burst from the ball and wrapped around Celebi as it flew above them.

Whatever power the Dark Ball held, Celebi could not break free. The light swallowed it, and an instant later it was trapped inside.

Celebi!

Sammy stared in horror. It had happened too fast. Charmeleon had just dodged Dark Tyranitars attack and could not help him stop it.

Hahaha! Vicious laughed, barely able to contain his joy. Prey never escapes a hunter. Celebi is mine!

Stop!

Ash charged recklessly at the robot. Somehow, with the agility of a Mankey, he scrambled up one of its legs and lunged for Vicious.

Vicious was still absorbed in his triumph. Ash managed to reach him, and they grappled in the cockpit.

Vicious was an adult and kicked Ash away. But when he looked at his hand, it was empty. The boy had snatched the Dark Ball.

Damn brat!

He jumped down from the cockpit. Before Ash could get up, Vicious took the ball back and kicked him aside.

You pests are a headache. If you care so much about Celebi, Ill use it against you!

He threw the Dark Ball. Come out, Dark Celebi! Show them your true power!

Black light flashed, and Celebi appeared before them again.

Its eyes were black now, and a frightening dark aura surrounded its body.

Celebi, drive them away!

At Viciouss command, Celebi swept an arm through the air. A powerful blast of wind erupted around it, hurling Ash upward and washing over Ethan and the others so fiercely they could barely open their eyes.

Ethan crossed his arms to shield his face. Seeing Ash flying high above them, he called, Gengar! Catch Ash!

Gengar shot from Ethans shadow, caught Ash, and carried him safely to the ground.

Celebi! Wake up! Sammy shouted. Dont let that power control you!

His words had no effect. Celebi looked at them with cold, distant eyes.

Its useless, Vicious said with a triumphant laugh. The Celebi you knew is gone. This is its new form. Now, Celebi, show me more of your power!

A black barrier formed around Celebi. Then a violent whirlwind spun up with the Pokemon at its center. Branches, soil, rocks, and flowers were pulled inward. More and more debris gathered until a gigantic sphere enclosed Celebi.

The wind dragged at Ethans group too. They clung to nearby trees to keep from being swept away. Their heavier Pokemon could hold their ground, but smaller ones such as Pikachu would have been carried into the storm if they lost their footing.

Stopping Celebi was impossible. It took all their strength just to avoid being hurt.

When the wind weakened, the forest around them lay in ruins. Fallen trees were everywhere, as though a real hurricane had torn through.

The sphere at its center had grown to more than a hundred meters across.

Lifted by Celebis power, Vicious rose into the air above it.

Perhaps he had grown bored of playing with them. The sphere carried him toward the far end of the forest. Jessie, James, and Meowth dared not stay behind. They grabbed vines hanging from it and climbed aboard.

It moved north, crushing every obstacle in its way and leaving a long, ugly scar through the trees.

What do we do now? Misty asked, watching Vicious disappear. Half an hour earlier, everything had seemed normal. The change had come so quickly.

What else? We go after him. Ethan stood and helped Erika to her feet. Vicious took Celebi. Well bring it back.

Right! Ash nodded hard. We cant leave Celebi with someone like him!

Agreed, they hurried after the sphere. They had not gone far when voices called down from above.

Mr. Ethan! Ash!

They looked up in surprise. A small airship was flying toward them. Three people sat aboard. Two were Towa and Diana from Arborville.

What were they doing here?

The craft came down before them, and Diana asked at once, We saw that tornado from the village. What happened?

It wasnt a tornado, Sammy said quickly. Celebi caused it. A Pokemon hunter captured Celebi, and we need to catch up with him!

Everyone climbed aboard. As they traveled, Sammy explained what had happened yesterday and today.

Those rotten Pokemon hunters! The third person, a man steering the airship, struck its side with his fist before Towa or Diana could respond. How could they do that to Celebi? I wont forgive them!

Noticing Ethan and the others looking at him, Diana made an introduction. This is White. He lives in our village. The airship is his. When we saw the tornado, we asked him to bring us here.

White was a man of about twenty-seven or twenty-eight, with slightly dark skin and loose, casual clothes. Ethan immediately noticed the necklace of three gold coins around his neck.

It seemed he held a position in Arborville similar to Dianas.

Hello. White nodded warmly. I handle supplies for the village. Diana and I grew up together, too.

Grew... grew up together?

A cry of heartbreak came from behind Ethan. No one needed to turn to know Brock had made it.

Brock fell for one woman after another, and his fragile heart had broken yet again.

White flew after Vicious. With the airship, they no longer had to worry about falling behind. Within minutes, they were above the enormous sphere.

It had changed shape while traveling.

Almost as if it had evolved, the mass had sprouted arms, legs, a head, and wings. Made of branches and weeds, it was neither quite human nor quite Pokemon. It looked terrifying.

Celebi! Sammy leaned out and shouted down. Weve come to save you!

Ethan thought that was a poor idea. Yelling would do nothing for Celebi and would alert Vicious to their presence.

Sure enough, Vicious scowled when he saw them pursuing him like flies he could not shake. Celebi, bring them down!

The plant creature raised its head, opened its huge mouth, and fired a fearsome wave of energy at the airship.

Oh, no!

White turned the controls hard and managed to angle the airship aside just before the blast reached them.

It still smashed a ballast compartment beneath the craft. The airship tilted and began falling toward a lake below.

Ah! Misty screamed. The others scrambled for something to hold. White gritted his teeth and wrestled with the controls, bringing the listing craft down onto the lake.

Only then did Ethan realize Whites airship could travel on water as well as through the air. It floated safely on the surface.

We made it, White said, wiping sweat from his forehead. He could not resist a little pride. Not a bad ship, is it?

Stop showing off. Diana patted his shoulder and turned to the others. Is everyone all right?

Before anyone could answer, the creature on the shore opened its mouth again. Another blast of energy shot toward them.

For all its frightening size, the wooden monster had no power of its own. Celebi inside it was the one attacking.

The blast arrived almost at once.

BOOM!

Whites beloved craft took the hit and exploded. The force threw Ethan and the others into the water.

Splash!

Cold lake water closed over Ethans head, and he sank beneath the surface.

But the man blessed by the God of the Sea could still move freely in water. After a moments alarm, he opened his eyes and searched around him.

He spotted Erika closest to him and swam straight to her. He caught her and brought her toward the surface.

They broke through the water together.

The airship was in pieces and burning. Nearby, Ash, Misty, and the others emerged one by one.

They swam to shore. Once there, they counted heads without bothering about their soaked clothes. Towa, Diana, and White were missing.

They were about to dive back in when the water splashed. White and Diana appeared, helping Towa between them.

White sank onto a rock and looked back at the ruined craft with a rueful shake of his head. A moment ago he had been bragging about it. Now it was gone.

Ethan looked around the lake. It seemed more and more familiar. Wasnt this where they had camped last night?

He could even see the traces of their campsite not far away.

After all their fighting and fleeing, they had somehow ended up right back here.

Chapter 585: Let the Story Play Out

Heavy footsteps shook the ground. Everyone turned. The enormous creature of branches and weeds was striding toward them.

Ash and the others had no time to rest. They sent out their Pokemon again, determined to free Celebi.

Pikachu, Charmeleon, and Mistys and Brocks Pokemon charged from either side. Vicious answered with Dark Tyranitar and several other Dark Pokemon.

Ashs group was trapped at the lakeshore. They had been thrown into the water, and Whites airship was destroyed. There was nowhere left to retreat.

They could only fight with everything they had. This time none of them held back.

Battles broke out all around. The fighting spread quickly beyond the edge of the lake.

Brock even sent out Onix. Using its massive body, it wrapped around Dark Tyranitar to create an opening for Ash and the others.

Ash and Sammy took that chance. They ran to the base of the plant creature and began climbing it with their bare hands.

They hoped to reach Celebi while Vicious was distracted. Halfway up, however, the Team Rocket trio blocked their way.

Jessie, James, and Meowth had been hiding on the creature since climbing aboard earlier. At last, they had a useful role to play.

Heh! Jessie grinned. If you brats want to interfere with Lord Vicious, youll have to get past us!

Team Rocket! Ash shouted, angry and frantic. Get out of the way!

Not a chance, James said with a smile. You should hand over Pikachu instead!

They had clashed too many times for either side to back down. A fight began at once.

Ash and Sammy had left their Pokemon below in their hurry to climb. The trio had Meowth beside them and the high ground on their side. Their position was much easier to defend than to attack.

Pikachu saw Ash in danger and leaped onto the creature to help. That finally eased the pressure on the two boys.

Moves flew in every direction. Nowhere on the field was safe.

Erika brought out Leafeon to stand guard before herself, Towa, Diana, and White. The three villagers had no Pokemon with them and had come only to help. She would not let them be harmed.

Only Ethan had yet to take part.

Since arriving in the village two nights earlier and realizing Celebi was involved, he had been waiting for an opportunity.

He wanted to end the crisis, send Sammy back to his own time, and find a way to catch Celebi himself.

His memories of the movie were too hazy to guide every move. He could recall something of its ending, but a battle changed from moment to moment. He had not found the right point to step in.

Was this it? Or should he wait a little longer?

If Ethan truly wanted to defeat Celebi, he had the strength and plenty of chances to do it. Viciouss Dark Balls would not change that.

But what then?

Celebi would take Sammy back to the past, and Ethan would come away empty-handed.

Still, he could not simply leave things as they were. First they had to get Celebi out of that monstrous shell.

Ethan glanced toward Towa, Diana, and White. Their attention was fixed on the battle. He slipped behind a large tree.

From a pouch at his right side, he took a Great Ball and released the Pokemon inside.

A graceful blue Pokemon appeared before him: Suicune, one of his Legendary partners.

Suicune, the embodiment of the north wind, had the power to purify water. In the movie Ethan remembered, its arrival had changed the battle. Ash and the others had rescued Celebi and ultimately cleansed the dark energy controlling it.

Whether another Suicune was nearby, Ethan did not know. His own might even be the one he remembered seeing in the film.

He could not gamble on a second Suicune appearing. He had to send his and let it play its part so events could move forward.

Pointing toward the plant creature, he said quietly, See that? Celebi is inside. Find a way to get it out and purify the dark energy around it. The man beside it has Dark Balls. Dont let him catch you.

Suicune nodded and raced toward the creature.

Not far away, Towa, Diana, and White watched the battle helplessly. They could see how it was going, but they had no way to assist.

Then an elegant blue shape flashed past them and bounded into the fighting.

When they recognized it, all three stared in shock. It was Suicune, the Legendary Pokemon!

Erika alone looked for Ethan as soon as Suicune appeared. Sure enough, he emerged at an unhurried pace from the direction it had come.

He gave her a nod. She understood that this was the Suicune he had caught.

So he had finally decided to intervene.

Suicune reached the battlefield as Dark Tyranitar attacked Onix. It sprang behind Tyranitar and kicked it down, then leaped onward toward Celebis wooden shell.

Vicious noticed it at once.

What? Suicune? Shock turned to delight. Excellent! Another rare Pokemon right here. You can join my collection too!

He drew a Dark Ball and threw it without hesitation. Suicune had been watching for exactly that. It dodged cleanly.

So alert? Vicious frowned. Suicunes caution surprised him, but he was too pleased at the chance to capture one of Johtos Legendary beasts to dwell on it.

His attention shifted from Celebi to Suicune. His hold over Celebi weakened.

Above them, Pikachu fought brilliantly. Within a few exchanges, it defeated Jessie, James, and Meowth.

Luck did not save them this time. One Iron Tail sent all three tumbling from the creature into the forest below, where they vanished among the trees.

With the way clear, Ash and Sammy climbed higher. They soon reached the creatures mouth.

Inside its wide-open jaws, they could see Celebi wrapped in a tangle of protective vines.

Celebi, stop! Ash called.

Please dont do this anymore! Sammy shouted.

Their voices alerted Celebi. It opened its eyes wide, and an invisible barrier spread outward from its body, throwing both boys away.

They nearly fell, but each had a firm grip. After sliding down a little, they climbed back toward the mouth.

Vicious was busy trying to catch Suicune. It darted left and right without a pattern, and several more Dark Balls missed.

As his supply dwindled, he grew hesitant.

Tyranitar! Forget those brats Pokemon and deal with Suicune!

Before Dark Tyranitar could obey, Vicious heard voices behind him. He turned and saw the two boys at the creatures mouth.

They had slipped past him. Damn them! Why were they so persistent?

He had never faced an opponent quite like Ash. An ordinary Trainer would not climb a giant creature like a Mankey, risking everything to rescue a Pokemon. Even the usually steadier Sammy had followed Ashs lead into danger.

Celebi, get rid of them! Vicious ordered.

He was too late. Ash and Sammy had already crawled into the creatures mouth and followed the vines to Celebi.

Facing Celebi in its shroud of dark energy, Ash cried, Dont listen to him! Remember who you really are!

Ash had brought out his strongest weapons: an appeal to memory and a plea to wake up. This time they worked.

Dark energy surged around Celebi. For a brief moment, clarity returned to its eyes. It was struggling against the power inside it.

Encouraged, Ash and Sammy reached for Celebi and tried to pull it free from the center of the vines.

Their touch shook it further. The entire wooden creature began to tremble out of control.

Vicious lost his balance outside. He had to crouch and grab the grass beneath him to keep from falling.

Everyone noticed the change.

Misty and Brock brightened. Ash and Sammy must have done something inside. With renewed hope, they pressed their attack on the Dark Pokemon.

Vicious had lost control of the fight. His Pokemon fought like mindless instruments of destruction, and with Suicunes help, the others knocked them down. The balance of the battle changed in moments.

You miserable pests!

When Vicious saw all his Dark Pokemon defeated, he ground his teeth in anger.

Then he noticed something worse. The Dark Ball on his vest that held Celebi under control began leaking black smoke. It shook violently, as though about to burst.

Th-this cant be happening!

He snatched it up. The ball shattered in his hand, sending out a billow of smoke. Celebi had broken free of his control.

No!

He barely had time to cry out before the wooden creature collapsed beneath him. Vicious and the tangled branches fell together.

Inside it, Celebis power lifted Ash and Sammy without a breath of wind. The two boys and Celebi floated safely out and descended to the ground.

Rumble!

The huge mass of wood fell apart. Misty and the nearby Pokemon hurried away from the falling debris.

When the dust settled, Vicious was nowhere to be seen. Ruin lay everywhere.

Was it over?

Everyone but Ethan could hardly believe the result. Vicious had held the advantage only moments ago. How had it reversed so suddenly?

They had little time to think. Celebi landed with Ash and Sammy. Misty and the others forgot about Vicious and crowded around it.

Towa, Diana, and White approached slowly, eyes wide. Arborville stood at the entrance to this forest, and they had kept its legend for years, but this was their first sight of its true guardian.

So this was Celebi. It was beautiful beyond belief.

While everyone surrounded Celebi, Ethan stayed where he was and searched the wreckage with his eyes.

He knew Vicious would not be defeated so easily. The battlefield looked quiet, but the hunters final desperate move was still to come.

Ethan did not warn the others. They were close to the end, and each step from here could affect his chance to catch Celebi.

Suicune walked back to him. Ethan would have preferred not to reveal that he owned a Legendary Pokemon, but after defeating Dark Tyranitar, Suicune had returned to its Trainer without a thought.

Both Suicune and Raikou had accepted their situation and acknowledged Ethan as their Trainer. Neither would run away even if given the chance.

Such gradual changes could be powerful. Once they accepted their new lives, they would go on fighting beside him like his three Legendary birds and could never quite return to what they had been before.

Before Vicious reappeared, Ash cried out in shock.

Ethan went over. Celebis body was visibly shriveling. Its spirits had collapsed, and its breathing was faint.

H-how could this happen? Ash stared at it in disbelief.

Ethan understood at a glance. It must have exhausted its strength breaking free of the Dark Ball. The dark energy is striking back at it now. If we dont find a way to treat Celebi, its life could be in danger!

Chapter 586: Celebi Revives

Celebi slipped unconscious again. Its body was shriveled and gray, like a plant withering before their eyes. It seemed close to death.

Everyone gathered around it. Ash and Sammy were frantic. Ashs first thought was to get water, but when he turned toward the lake, he found it had changed.

The battle and explosion had destroyed much of the forest along its shore. Worse, leaking dark energy had spread through the water. The entire lake looked as though ink had been poured into it. Once clear, it was now murky and black.

This...

Ash gritted his teeth. His usually slow mind seemed to find an answer at once, and he turned to Ethan.

Ethan, I heard Suicune can purify water. Ask it to do something!

He did not appeal to Suicune directly. Ethans Pokemon were devoted to him. Gardevoir, Gengar, and Jolteon might listen to Erika, but his red Gyarados would obey no one else. Ash did not know what Suicune was like, so he asked Ethan.

Erika and the others simply looked at Ethan with hope. Sammy, Towa, Diana, and White, however, stared at him and then at the Pokemon beside him.

Could this Suicune actually belong to Ethan?

How was that possible? To people in Johto, Suicune and the other two Legendary beasts were noble beings beyond reach. None of them had imagined a Trainer could catch one like an ordinary Pokemon.

They did not want to believe it, but what happened next left no doubt.

Ethan turned to Suicune and nodded. Go on. Were counting on you.

He had sent Suicune out partly because he knew this would happen. Even if Ash had said nothing, Ethan would have asked it to purify the lake.

Suicune raised its head and called toward the sky, its voice somewhere between a deers and a leopards. Blue-green light wrapped around its body, warm and peaceful.

It sprang toward the lake. To everyones amazement, it did not sink. It stood on the water as though it weighed nothing.

With several more bounds, Suicune moved toward the center. Each time a hoof touched the black water, blue-green light bloomed outward. The darkness receded, and the water became clear again.

Everyone on shore watched silently. Suicune circled the lake like an elegant dancer. By the time it had completed its circuit, the dark energy was gone and the water was clean.

Suicune returned to Ethans side. Towa, Diana, and White looked at him again, their estimation of him rising. They wanted to speak but could not find the words.

Ash recovered first. He lowered Celebi into the water, hoping it would restore moisture to its withered body.

His hope was in vain. Celebi did not respond. It looked dead.

Celebi...

No matter how Ash called, there was no movement. Its chest no longer rose or fell.

Everyone understood. Erika sighed. Misty turned away to wipe her eyes. Towa, Diana, and White bowed their heads.

Ash and Sammy blamed themselves.

If only... if only Id rescued you sooner...

No, its my fault. If Id protected you better, that man couldnt have caught you...

The wild Pokemon seemed to sense what had happened. They emerged from the forest and called mournfully to Celebi.

It was as though the whole forest grieved for its guardian.

Only Ethan looked up at the sky, waiting for something.

He alone knew that the story should not end here.

A brilliant light flashed overhead. Blue-green radiance spread across the forest, just as it had when they first entered the Mysterious Forest. The voice of the forest that Towa remembered so well rang out again.

Is that... the sound of time travel?

They looked up, bewildered. What was happening? Could there be another Pokemon besides Celebi with the power to cross time?

The light brightened until they could barely keep their eyes open.

Once they managed to look again, dozens of Pokemon flew down from the sky.

Every one of them was a Celebi.

Before anyone could recover from the shock, several flew to the Celebi beside them. With psychic power, they lifted its lifeless body into the air. The others circled it as though performing a mysterious ritual.

Blue-green light blazed even more brightly.

Ethan and the others forced themselves to watch through the sting in their eyes. The fallen Celebi began to recover as though life were flowing back into it. Its body filled out, color returned, and at last its eyes opened.

In only a short time, it was lively again.

Incredible, Erika whispered. They brought a dead Pokemon back to life...

And I never knew Celebi had companions, Sammy said.

Ethan watched the sky, but he was not sure Erikas explanation was right.

True resurrection would involve powers beyond anything he understood. Perhaps this was a reversal of time. If Celebi could travel through time, maybe the others had turned this Celebis personal time back to a moment before it died.

After restoring it, the visiting Celebi exchanged nods with their companion and flew back into the sky. Just as they had arrived, they returned to their own times.

Another possibility struck Ethan: perhaps they were not separate companions at all, but the same Celebi from different moments in its life.

That was only a guess. Who could truly know? Scientists spent their lives pursuing mysteries like this.

Click.

Ethan took out his phone and photographed the scene. The light was so strong that the picture came out badly overexposed. He could make out only a few dozen dark specks. Without looking closely, no one would know they were Celebi.

It was enough for him. When he was old, the photograph might help him remember this extraordinary day and tell his children about it.

Celebi seemed delighted to be alive. It flew circles overhead, calling happily as it swooped back and forth.

Then, as it passed over the wreckage on its way toward Ethan and the others, a pair of powerful hands shot out and seized it.

What?

Celebi cried out. Ash and the others stared in shock. The hands belonged to Vicious. He had survived the collapse and crawled from the debris.

They had assumed he was buried beneath the wooden creature. He was alive after all.

Vicious bared his teeth in a savage grin. Without a word, he activated the jetpack on his back and flew away with Celebi in his grasp.

No!

Ash took off after him, but two running legs were no match for a jetpack.

As Vicious pulled farther away, Ethan flashed past on Dragonite and gave chase.

Leave the rest to me! Wait here until I get back!

He urged Dragonite forward. Trainer and Pokemon rose over the forest and rapidly closed the distance.

Everyone else had relaxed when Celebi recovered. Ethan had only grown more alert. They had not truly reached the end, and danger could still come at any moment.

Vicious had seized precisely such a moment.

As soon as he saw it happen, Ethan recalled Suicune into its Great Ball. He sent out Dragonite, mounted, and flew after the hunter in one swift sequence. He had moved before he could even say a word to Erika.

To anyone watching, his reflexes might have seemed extraordinary. Ethan knew he had been waiting for that chance for a long time.

Ash ran a few more steps and lost sight of both Vicious and Ethan.

He had heard Ethan say he would handle it. Ashs nature would not let him stand by.

Still running, he called back, Ethan and I will take care of the rest! Wait for us here!

Wait! Sammy sprinted after him. Im coming too!

Ash nodded. Their personalities were different, but they were close in age and shared a love of Pokemon. He already thought of Sammy as a friend and would not turn him away.

Ash reached for Charizards Poke Ball, thinking he and Sammy could ride it after Dragonite. His fingers touched his belt before he remembered: after the Silver Conference, he had transferred Charizard back to the Charicific Valley. It was not with him.

On foot, they could not hope to catch the two fliers.

But Ash was too determined to give up. He drew Noctowls Poke Ball instead and threw it high.

Noctowl, follow them!

Noctowl glanced toward the distant sky and understood. It nodded, spread its wings, and flew after Dragonite. Ash watched its course, then ran into the forest with Sammy. Soon they too were out of sight.

At the lake, Erika, Misty, Brock, Towa, Diana, and White watched them go.

Erika shook her head. Everything had happened so fast that Ethan was gone before she could react.

She was not worried for him. With so many powerful Pokemon at his side, it was his enemies who ought to fear for their safety.

Theyve gone after Vicious. We can trust them. Lets set up camp here while we wait.

Diana nodded. Everyone must be tired after all this. Ill make lunch.

Misty and the others agreed. There was nothing more they could do now but wait for Ethan and Ash to return.

White looked once at the wreck of his airship in the lake and sighed. It had been in perfect condition when they set out. What a loss to suffer through no fault of his own.

...

Above the forest, Vicious flew toward its edge with his jetpack.
